market.question: Will the highest temperature in Cape Town be 13°C on May 10?

assessment.reasoning: Cape Town airport forecast May 10 is high of 60°F (~15.5°C). 13°C bucket would require ~2-3°C below forecast. Cape Town autumn highs typically 16-21°C; 13°C high is unusually cold and unlikely without strong cold front. Market price 0.235 looks high vs base rate ~8-12%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possible passing cold front not captured in current forecast
